# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- 0.34" thick, 4.3 oz, 5,000mAh, and Qi2 15W wireless, which is the max an iPhone 17 gets from a 15W bank.
- 9to5Mac says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and runs cooler than competitors. Anker's page lists it as best fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- $54.99 on Anker's site, which shows a $5 auto-applied discount ending soon.
- [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Best slim with more capacity: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2)**
- 10,000mAh at about 0.5" thick and 195g. Macworld calls it an equal-slimmest 10K MagSafe pack.
- It supports 25W wireless, which the iPhone 17 can use, plus 45W wired and a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable.
- Android Central lists it at $42.99 on Amazon.
- Links to buy: [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) and [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html). Both have retailer buttons, and I couldn't open a direct product page.

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- 0.27" thick and 104g, so Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of its test group.
- The catch is that wireless speed is only 7.5W, so it's slow for a wireless top-up.
- Android Central lists it at $52.99 on Amazon, with a $69.99 list price, via the [same review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

## How to choose
- **Pocketability first:** the Anker Nano, or the Baseus Air if you can live with slower wireless charging.
- **A full charge or more from one bank:** the INIU. Macworld notes that 5K banks usually reach only about 60-75% on a phone, while 10K banks give roughly 1.5-2 charges.
- **Cases:** Anker notes that non-magnetic or thick cases (over about 2.5mm) can break the connection, so use a MagSafe/Qi2-compatible case.

Prices change often, so check the retailer's checkout before buying.
